categories.title: PET Preform Moulds
categories.short: PET preform tooling for beverage, edible oil and technical packaging projects.
categories.detail: A starting category for PET preform tooling. Neck finish, preform weight, cavity count, hot runner and cycle requirements are confirmed from the buyer drawing and approved sample.
checks: Target PET grade and preform weight
Cavity plan, cycle target and machine interface

categories.title: Bottle Cap Moulds
categories.short: Precision cap mould concepts for beverage, oil, food, personal-care and industrial closures.
categories.detail: Cap tooling is reviewed around the closure drawing, tamper-evident band, thread, hinge or liner design, material and production machine. Final technical data is supplied after project review.
checks: Closure drawing, thread and sealing surface
PP or selected resin and shrinkage assumptions
Cap style: screw, flip-top, tethered or custom
Cavity balance, ejection and inspection plan

categories.title: Bottle Moulds
categories.short: Bottle mould direction for blow-moulded and injection-related packaging applications.
categories.detail: Bottle mould projects start from the bottle drawing, target volume, resin, wall distribution, machine interface and surface finish. Approved product files will be added as they are received.
checks: Bottle drawing, volume and critical dimensions
Blow machine interface and mould cooling

categories.title: Knife & Fork Moulds
categories.short: Cutlery tooling category for disposable, reusable and custom packaging programs.
categories.detail: Knife and fork moulds are assessed from the part geometry, resin, gate location, cavity balance, ejection and food-contact documentation required for the target market.
checks: Gate, runner, ejection and cavity balance
Surface texture, flash control and inspection points

services.title: Mould Design & Engineering
services.text: Review drawings, parting lines, cooling, ejection and the production machine interface before tooling is approved.

services.title: Precision Manufacturing
services.text: Coordinate machining, EDM, fitting and assembly against the approved tooling brief and inspection checkpoints.

services.title: Trial, Sampling & Optimisation
services.text: Plan trial shots, sample feedback, dimensional checks and controlled changes before production handover.
